numbers_status: provisional-defaults: no baseline measurements exist yet. Re-derive from the first real bakeoff; any change bumps rule_version.

quality_floor.why: do not promote a tiny model that is far worse overall

language_floor.why: a global average must not hide a major EN or KO regression

ambiguity_floor.why: false positives on ambiguous/colliding names are the product risk

size_ceiling.why: do not accept huge binary/WASM cost for marginal quality

tie_handling.procedure: Candidates must be on the Pareto frontier and pass every guardrail. One survivor is recommended. Several survivors are auto-resolved only when they are quality-equivalent (then the one no larger on every size dimension) or size-equivalent (then the one no worse on every quality dimension). Anything else needs an explicit ADR tradeoff decision; the machine never picks by one dimension.

waivers.rule: A guardrail may only be waived per candidate and guardrail with a written reason and ADR reference.
